property.name: Web View Address
property.tooltip: The page the Controller's Experience Button opens in the Navigators.

property.name: Experience Button Subtitle
property.tooltip: Show live TV / badge status under the Experience Button icon, or a static "TV Notifications" label.

property.name: Number of TV Members
property.tooltip: How many TV members are used. Only this many Member entries are shown.

property.name: Number of Subgroups
property.tooltip: How many named subgroups are used.

property.name: Subgroup 1 Members
property.tooltip: Member numbers in this subgroup, separated by commas, for example 1, 3, 4.

property.name: Subgroup 2 Members
property.tooltip: Member numbers in this subgroup, separated by commas, for example 1, 3, 4.

property.name: Subgroup 3 Members
property.tooltip: Member numbers in this subgroup, separated by commas, for example 1, 3, 4.

property.name: Subgroup 4 Members
property.tooltip: Member numbers in this subgroup, separated by commas, for example 1, 3, 4.

property.name: Subgroup 5 Members
property.tooltip: Member numbers in this subgroup, separated by commas, for example 1, 3, 4.

property.name: Subgroup 6 Members
property.tooltip: Member numbers in this subgroup, separated by commas, for example 1, 3, 4.

property.name: Number of Profiles
property.tooltip: How many profiles can be sent. Lowering it hides profiles but does not delete them.

property.name: Profile to Edit
property.tooltip: The profile shown in the editor below. Every change is saved to it immediately.

property.name: Profile Targets
property.tooltip: Who the profile is sent to: All TVs, one connected TV or a subgroup, listed by name. The list follows TV and subgroup renames.

property.name: Small Icon Color
property.tooltip: Use TV Default = each room driver's Default Small Icon Color. Custom = the colour picked below.

property.name: Small Icon Custom Color
property.tooltip: Colour picker, used when the colour above is Custom.

property.name: Message Color
property.tooltip: Use Default = TvOverlay's white text. Custom = the colour picked below.

property.name: Message Custom Color
property.tooltip: Colour picker, used when the colour above is Custom.

property.name: Icon Color
property.tooltip: No Tint = the icon keeps its own colours. Custom = tint it with the colour picked below.

property.name: Icon Custom Color
property.tooltip: Colour picker, used when the colour above is Custom.

property.name: Border Color
property.tooltip: Use Default = TvOverlay's white border. Custom = the colour picked below.

property.name: Border Custom Color
property.tooltip: Colour picker, used when the colour above is Custom.

property.name: Background Color
property.tooltip: Use Default = TvOverlay's 40% black. Custom = the colour and opacity picked below.

property.name: Background Custom Color
property.tooltip: Colour picker, used when the colour above is Custom.

property.name: Background Opacity
property.tooltip: How solid the badge background is: 100% = solid, 0% = fully transparent.

property.name: Clock Visibility
property.tooltip: Visibility of TvOverlay's clock, 0 (hidden) to 95. -1 = leave unchanged. At 0, badges are hidden too unless Fixed Notification Visibility is set.

property.name: Fixed Notification Visibility
property.tooltip: Visibility of badges, 0 to 95. -1 = same as the clock (TvOverlay's default). -2 = leave unchanged.

event.description: When a profile's badge is removed (manually, from the TV Notifications page, by programming or on expiry)

event.description: When a profile's badge is removed because its Expiration runs out (Badge Cleared fires too)
